dedupe_keys.name: antiviral antibiotics and decongestants in wastewater treatment plants and receiving rivers in the thames catchment

description: Antiviral, antibiotics and decongestants in wastewater treatment plants and receiving rivers in the Thames catchment is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. This dataset contains the concentration of eleven antibiotics (trimethoprim, oxytetracycline, ciprofloxacin, azithromycin, cefotaxime, doxycycline, sulfamethoxazole, erythromycin, clarithromycin, ofloxacin, norfloxacin), three decongestants (naphazoline, oxymetazoline, xylometazoline) and the antiviral drug oseltamivir's active metabolite, oseltamivir carboxylate, measured at 21 locations within the River Thames catchment in England. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Benson Sewage Works, Hydrography, Oxford Sewage Works, River Thames, River Thames catchment (UK). It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
